tailoring.headline: Front-End Developer | JavaScript, PWA & SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Specialist
tailoring.summary: Backend and front-end engineer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in JavaScript, responsive design and Progressive Web Application integration, building headless commerce APIs (OCC, REST) on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211). Proven record of designing data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM, leading CI/CD deployments, and translating business requirements into functional specifications within Agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SFCC Front-End Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Neethu Raj’s commitment to delivering cutting-edge e-commerce experiences. With over five years designing and extending SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in front-end development, JavaScript, PWA integration and headless APIs that align with your SFCC goals.

bullets.label: Front-End Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented full-stack storefront features on SAP Commerce Cloud, customizing UI components and ensuring responsive design across devices.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: I built OCC REST Web Services and integrated PIM/ERP data pipelines, delivering reliable headless APIs that parallel SFCC’s commerce services.

bullets.label: PWA & Responsive UI
bullets.text: For Shell I created Progressive Web Application front-ends and responsive layouts, enhancing user experience and performance on mobile and desktop.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: I consistently delivered within Scrum teams, leading CI/CD cycles on CCv2 and collaborating with international stakeholders to meet release schedules.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: Neethu Raj’s focus on building high-performance SFCC front-end solutions aligns perfectly with my passion for creating responsive, headless commerce experiences. I admire the company’s hybrid work model that blends collaboration with flexibility, and I am eager to apply my proven JavaScript, PWA and API integration expertise to help accelerate your product roadmap and deliver superior shopper experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Neethu Raj to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud front-end expertise in a forward-thinking SFCC environment, driving innovative, responsive e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior e-commerce developer with 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud. I’m excited about your SFCC Front-End role and would love to discuss how my JavaScript and PWA experience can add value.
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your front-end stack by applying my proven JavaScript and PWA expertise to build responsive SFCC components, and I will streamline data integration using my experience with OCC-style APIs and PIM-ERP pipelines, reducing time-to-market.
tailoring.insight: The posting highlights a hybrid work model and the need for experienced SFCC front-end developers; my background in headless commerce and hybrid Agile teams positions me to deliver high-quality UI features quickly.
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a senior e-commerce developer with 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud platforms. I am drawn to Neethu Raj’s focus on SFCC front-end innovation and hybrid collaboration. I can bring proven JavaScript, PWA and headless API experience, plus agile delivery skills, to accelerate your projects. I noticed the role emphasizes hybrid work and strong front-end expertise; I am ready to contribute from day one. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
